items_ai.summary_zh: 一名 Nvidia 员工涉嫌 AI GPU 走私丑闻，他的家和办公桌都被搜查。他因伪造和违反信任的指控而被拘留。与此同时，英伟达正在缩减其买家名单，以根除潜在的走私链。

items_ai.title: Valve says that Steam Machine reservations won't be fulfilled until ‘the end of this year’ — company also releases CAD files for the PC console’s external shell under Creative Commons
items_ai.summary: Everyone who reserved the Steam Machine can get the chance to buy one before the year ends. Valve says availability differs between models and regions, and that some areas have already completed the reservations, meaning the company is opening the sale of the PC console to waitlisted buyers.
